_comment: Copy to config.json and fill in. The installer does this for you. config.json is gitignored and is never touched by an update.
_model: the cost knob: which Claude model runs everything (opus = best and most expensive)
_allowed_tools: tools that run with NO approval card. Read-only default keeps RISKS.md's promise; adding Bash/PowerShell/Write/Edit gives the agent your machine without asking
_teleport: phone takeover of desk Claude Code sessions; guarded by the same approval cards AND the target project's own permission rules
